description: Add tracks or episodes to a playlist. Max 100 URIs per call.

check_duplicates.description: Skip URIs that are already in the playlist instead of appending them (default: false)

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

position.description: Insert at this index; appends if omitted. 0-based index into the playlist's current item order (0 = the first item).

uris.description: Track or episode URIs to add

name: add_to_playlist
